about: What each register row (FEASIBILITY.md §2, keyed by the start of its first cell) takes from W1: 'encoder' = current-frame latents, distances between them or probes on them; 'predictor' = action-conditioned predicted / imagined latents or their error (surprise); 'both' = the row compares or combines the two. Author's classification (WS-091 review round, 2026-11-01); basis = where in road-to-robotics the method is stated.
